soft_notes.topic: grade_code whitespace stripping deferred to service layer
soft_notes.observation: LLD files[13] and schema.json constraints both say `grade_code constr min_length=1, strip_whitespace`. Plan.md (T-007) explicitly deferred this with the inline comment `# strip in service if needed`. Plan.json definition_of_done line says `GradeCreate uses strip_whitespace=True per LLD` — that DoD line contradicts plan.md and is NOT what the implementation does.
soft_notes.risk: Without stripping, a user could submit '  DIM  ' as grade_code; the UNIQUE(grade_code) DB constraint would not collide with seeded 'DIM'. Two grades with effectively the same code would be created — AC-011 bypass.
soft_notes.mitigation: Handle in T-013 GradeService.create_grade: strip before calling get_by_code() and before passing to repo.create(). Service-layer strip is a valid placement per the layered architecture; just needs explicit implementation. If T-013 plan.md does not already strip, the critic on T-013 should flag.
soft_notes.actionable_for: T-013 dev pass (or follow-up plan revision to align T-007 with LLD directly)
